item.title: NET announces savings of £200 with January offer
item.description: Nottingham Express Transit (NET) has announced a huge offer this January, saving tram users more than £200 on an Adult Annual ticket, which can be used for unlimited tram travel all year. item.description: Car thieves, dangerous drivers, and violent criminals all had cause to rue the presence of our remote-controlled eyes in the sky as the drones team enjoyed its most productive year yet. item.description: The Mayor of the East Midlands is celebrating crossing the halfway point of her Loop around the region.
